components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:0 24px;background:var(--white,#FFFFFF);font-family:Noto Sans Thai,sans-serif;font-size:14px}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:24px 0;color:var(--ink,#00384C);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a:active,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink,#00384C)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{font-weight:700}.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:15px;height:3px;background:var(--cyan,#44E0F8)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#00384C);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: An untouched App home is the sole Hero product image, framed with native HTML/CSS on a cyan product plane beside a white information plane. No generated raster is selected for visitor pages. Competitors inform hierarchy and content responsibilities; reviewed copy remains the product authority.
keyCharacteristics: One complete original App home, separate from the white reading plane.
Text-led online product explanation and a subordinate complete repayment screenshot.
Company facts and quiet reading areas with independent responsibilities.
Natural Thai typography and consistent native interactions.

rules.name: Chapter Rhythm
rules.body: Use white for navigation and the Hero information plane, cyan for its product plane and final action, ink for primary online explanation, neutral surfaces for repayment, process and help.

rules.name: Thai Integrity
rules.body: Preserve natural Thai wrapping and zero Thai letter spacing; numeric tracking does not apply to Thai text.

rules.name: Image Integrity
rules.body: Keep untouched App images complete at natural ratios. A neutral native frame may separate them from the background; no generated device or props are selected.

dos: Use original master Logo and complete real App screenshots.
Use original screenshots to explain actual functions with explicit example captions.
Retain real pending download/legal states and keyboard access.
Verify each required viewport with actual rendered screenshots.
donts: Do not reintroduce rejected generated still life, unselected hardware frames, people photos, fake App interfaces or approval evidence.
Do not crop phones into half-screen decoration or paint over product content.
Do not invent financial claims, store links, payment QR codes or license resources.
Do not treat metadata or previous-round QA as current test results.
